project_type: Next.js 14 App Router - AI-powered economic news intelligence platform
build_system: Next.js via bun (npm/node not available, but bun handles everything). Use `bun run build` and `bun run lint`.
test_framework: No test suite currently. ESLint is the only quality gate.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run lint` - must pass with no errors. 2. Run `bun run build` - must complete successfully generating all pages and API routes. 3. Ensure no TypeScript errors.
environment_constraints: No node/npm available - only `bun` (v1.2.14). Use `bun run build`, `bun run lint`, `bun add <pkg>`. No Docker. OPEN_INTERNET mode - can install any packages from registries. No OPENAI_API_KEY set - AI features must gracefully fall back to mock/algorithmic data.
contribution_requirements: Work on `feat/quant-feed-mvp` branch. Do not push to main. Commit all changes to this branch.
key_patterns: - Pages in app/ directory using Next.js App Router, all client components use 'use client' directive. - API routes in app/api/ with force-dynamic exports. - Data hooks in lib/hooks/useApiData.ts fetching from internal API routes with mock data fallback. - AI modules in lib/ai/ using OpenAI with graceful fallback when no key. - News data stored in /tmp on Vercel (ephemeral), or falls back to mock-data.ts. - Styling: Tailwind CSS with dark mode, bg-[#0a0a0f] base, indigo-400 accents, gray-800/XX cards. - Graph: currently `react-force-graph-2d` with dynamic import (ssr: false). - RSS fetcher in lib/news/fetcher.ts parsing multiple Indian/international feeds.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js pages and API routes | components/ - React UI components | lib/ - utilities (types, mock-data, hooks, ai/, news/) | data/ - gitkeep only | public/ - favicon
